text:
B: Hiya duck! I'm Stacey. Ooh, your kitchen looks like mine, I said that about your photo.
A: Kerry. Yeah, it's a state, sorry. I've not had a minute.
B: No, you should see mine at tea time. Where are you?
A: Bridgwater, Somerset. You?
B: Sutton-in-Ashfield. Near Mansfield. I'm a care assistant, in a care home.
A: Oh, fair play. That's a hard job. I'm on tills, supermarket.
B: Aw, I did bar work and shop work for years before. The customers are the worst bit, aren't they?
A: I had one kick off over ten pence today. I've told everyone about it now, I can't let it go.
B: Ten pence! I'd have gone mental. Have you got kids?
A: Callum, seventeen. He's at college doing mechanics.
B: Mine's sixteen! Kai. GCSEs this year. His dad walked out when he was a baby so it's been me, really. Done it all myself.
A: Same. Callum's dad's not around. My partner Lee's been brilliant though, eleven years now.
B: Aw. Me and Dean are nine. We'll get married when someone else pays for it, I always say.
A: Ha! I can't see the point. Ten grand on one day? I'd rather have it in the bank.
B: Oh, I'd want the whole thing, the dress, the doves, everything. Then a honeymoon in Dubai.
A: Dubai. You want to get married in Dubai?
B: Not married there, just go there after. Just to say I've been, do you know what I mean? I've done Tenerife loads.
A: I went to Tenerife for my fortieth. Hated it.
B: No! What was wrong with it?
A: Too hot, too many English people moaning. I'd rather a caravan at Brean, to be honest.
B: Oh, we do Skegness with my mum's side, the caravan crowd. I love it but I like a bit of sun as well. We pay the holiday off monthly. Same as Tyson, that's my dog. He's on finance too.
A: Your dog's on finance?
B: French bulldog! They're two grand, duck.
A: Two grand for a dog. God. I'd be up all night worrying about that. We've had months where I didn't know if we'd make the rent.
B: Oh, no, it's fine, it's all, you know, it's sorted. Dean does that side. Anyway, do you do these surveys a lot? I do loads, for the vouchers.
A: All the time. Bit of extra money. This one's odd though. I didn't get that puzzle.
B: Oh God, me neither! I panicked. I thought they'd think I was thick.
A: Nobody's going to think that. It's daft, that puzzle. Here, have you heard of a barm?
B: A what? Is that like a cob?
A: Oh, not you as well...
